issue.title: [arm64-osx] Multi-arch triplets result in a CMake error

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

repository.name: vcpkg
repository.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Setting multiple architectures in triplet file results in an error.

**Environment**
- OS: macOS Big Sur
- Compiler: Apple clang version 12.0.0 (clang-1200.0.32.29)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a new triplet file, copied from `triplets/community/arm64-osx.cmake`
2. Change the last line (containing `VCPKG_OSX_ARCHITECTURES`) to contain both archs: `set(VCPKG_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64;x86_64")`
3. Try to install any package.

**Expected behavior**
The package should build

**Failure logs** 
```
CMake Error: The source directory "/Users/omartijn/git/vcpkg/buildtrees/detect_compiler/universal-osx-rel/x86_64" does not exist.
Specify --help for usage, or press the help button on the CMake GUI.
```

**Additional context**
According to the docs, th `VCPKG_OSX_ARCHITECTURES` maps directory to `CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES`, which works just fine with multiple architectures set.

body:
As we've been experiencing this issue too I did a bit of digging to see if I could figure out where the issue is coming from. It seems that providing an argument with a `;` inside needs to be escaped due to how lists work in CMake.

When I change your triplet into the following, they build as fat binaries:
```cmake
set(VCPKG_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE "x86_64\;arm64")
set(VCPKG_CRT_LINKAGE dynamic)
set(VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE static)

set(VCPKG_CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Darwin)
set(VCPKG_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 10.10)
set(VCPKG_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "x86_64\;arm64")
```

Note the quotes around the arguments, and the escaped `;` inside the quoted string.
Note too that I've added `VCPKG_OSX_ARCHITECTURES` as without it it didn't work for me to get the actual fat binary out.

issue.body:
**Describe the pull request**
This expands the architecture lists with escape characters. When
building FAT binaries for macos using multiple architectures in the
values they need to be escaped otherwise they are passed on to CMake
incorrectly #14932

- #### What does your PR fix?  
  Fixes #14932

- #### Does your PR follow the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/maintainers/maintainer-guide.md)?  
  `yes`

body:
As having to escape these variables contradicts the statement in the triplets documentation: https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/users/triplets.md#vcpkg_osx_architectures

I just opened a PR that fixes this within vcpkg. Then you can just use the following like you would have been able to in pure CMake.

```cmake
set(VCPKG_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE x86_64 arm64)
```

**Describe the pull request**

- #### What does your PR fix?
  Fixes [#25294, ](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/25294), allowing boost libraries to be built when VCPKG_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE is a list of architectures arm64 and x86_64.

- #### Which triplets are supported/not supported? Have you updated the [CI baseline](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/scripts/ci.baseline.txt)?
  Needed to support triplet arm64-x64-osx that builds unified libraries. Not yet contributed to vcpkg proper.
  I have  not updated the ci baseline.

- #### Does your PR follow the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/maintainers/maintainer-guide.md)?
